_doc: Precedence, canonical: (1) an EXACT name match in the hardcoded TOOL_DEFS map wins;
(2) every other '<connectorId>_*' name routes to the connector bridge.
So a static tool sharing a connector's prefix is benign ONLY while no exact name
clash exists (test/connectorStaticPrecedence.test.js proves the precedence rule).
A NEW overlap must either rename the connector tool (prometheus 'instant_query'
precedent) or land here as a reviewed entry with tool, connector, reason, date.
Entries whose connector is not in the registry are DORMANT (pre-seeded for an
unmerged branch); an entry whose collision no longer occurs is STALE and fails
the namespace test. Connector-vs-connector prefix collisions and unsafe connector
ids can NEVER be allowlisted here.
Enforced by classifyNamespaceCollisions() in registry.js via
test/connectorNamespace.test.js and surfaced loudly at agentTools boot.
